lore: The Reef's newest shelf is living coral. Every save written into a cell wears it a little, and a cell that wears through goes white and never takes another save. Hot island saves move every tide; the old archives sit still on fresh coral. Spread the wear, or the shelf dies young.

lines.start: Nine living cells and six saves to keep. Spread the wear.
lines.write: Save's in. The coral took the mark.
lines.relocate: Moved an old archive onto worn coral. Fresh cells for the hot saves.
lines.retire: That cell's gone white. It will never take another save.
lines.win: Season's done and the shelf still lives.
lines.fail: No living cell left for the save. The shelf is bleached.
